notes: Training set for the abuse vector check (src/services/abuseVectors.js).
Every sentence becomes one vector. A new feedback is compared with the vectors of each abuse type separately, and with the clean ones, so each type of abuse is recognised by its own examples.

abuse: sentences that must never be delivered, grouped by type. They are deliberately free of swear words (the word list already catches those): the point is politely worded abuse that no word list can see.
clean: sentences that are fine to deliver, especially ones that look like abuse on the surface: harsh criticism of work, slang praise, and innocent uses of words such as body, kill, photos or meet.
After changing this file run  node ml/train-abuse.js  and then  node ml/evaluate-abuse.js  from the backend folder, and restart the server.
